purpose: Exhaustive Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 skill catalog coverage tracker
rule: A category is not considered complete until every indexed source record is represented and every record has been checked for duplicates, variants, CaC restrictions, unlock method, costs, and mechanics. Indexed records must not be presented as fully verified mechanics.
next_verification_work: Individual skill pages and official/game sources
Unlock source and exact drop conditions
Damage, modifiers, buffs, debuffs, hit properties and tracking
current_research_focus: Post-corruption canonical database integrity is reconciled at 497 skills and 862 PQ relationship edges. Acquisition fields are complete and PQ↔skill parity is complete for current canonical scope. Restriction-gap review remains evidence-bound with 27 null race_restriction records; version/patch provenance is the next substantive field-level layer.
validation_blocker: Repository Quality, Clean Internal Artifacts, Wiki Data Audit, and Skills Sync continue to report failure on GitHub Actions. Job step/log diagnostics are unavailable through the connected GitHub API, so failure causes are not being guessed.
workflow_validation_note: Skills Sync trigger coverage now includes docs/data/skills.json and docs/data/skills-index.json.

canonical_reconciliation_2026_09_27.distinction: The 561 source-category index is a coverage universe, not a canonical-record count. Canonical skills.json remains authoritative.
canonical_reconciliation_2026_09_27.projection_rule: Indexes/catalogs/research batches are evidence or projections only and cannot override canonical skills.json.

catalog_identity_reconciliation_2026_09_.methodology: Compared exact case-insensitive skill names from the 12 maintained category catalogs against authoritative docs/data/skills.json. Duplicate category appearances are de-duplicated for the unique-universe count. Unavailable-for-CaC is supporting evidence only.
catalog_identity_reconciliation_2026_09_.interpretation: The 112 indexed-only names are not automatically missing canonical records: many may be cast-only, variant-specific, duplicate-looking, historical, or otherwise outside the current canonical corpus scope. The 28-name overlap with the unavailable-for-CaC catalog identifies a strong cast-only review subset, not an automatic promotion list. The canonical duplicate-name collision is preserved for identity reconciliation.
catalog_identity_reconciliation_2026_09_.next: Recompute indexed-only universe against the 497-record canonical corpus; prioritize directly evidenced Future Warrior skills and preserve cast-only/variant exclusions.

acquisition_gap_census_2026_09_28.rule: Canonical skills.json is authoritative; missing-field status is an enrichment metric only.

ki_cost_gap_census_2026_09_28.rule: Null is preserved where evidence does not establish a numeric Ki activation cost; evasive Stamina costs are not converted into Ki costs by inference.

restriction_gap_census_2026_09_28.rule: Null race_restriction is an enrichment gap, not a restriction claim; usable_by_cac is not converted into a race restriction without direct evidence.
restriction_gap_census_2026_09_28.note: Six additional null race_restriction records were directly reviewed; no narrower race/gender/form restriction was established, so null remains authoritative.
